problem: Can AGIS reduce founder time by automating its own build/review loop?
bullets: AI R&D may itself be automated
hypothesis: A structured agent pipeline can cut cycle time without reducing eval quality.
experiment: Run Requirement→Plan→Build→Test→Review→Staging on one Golden Workflow and compare baseline.
metric: Cycle time / eval pass / human intervention

problem: How should AGIS improve from daily work without prompt drift?
bullets: Rules should only promote after retest
hypothesis: Versioned evidence-based instruction updates reduce repeated failures.
experiment: Track one recurring failure before/after checklist/test change.
